static_traits.marital_status: Mother of two (marital status Not mentioned)

static_traits.social_status: family support, but she avoids discussing job-search Anxiety with family; other interpersonal situations Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: after not yet receiving an offer from the most recent interview, I feel I can no longer convince employers to hire me, which makes me feel discouraged and Self-doubt. As interviews failed repeatedly, this feeling intensified, and it appears with every application or interview.
basic_info.core_demands: Recent job rejections have affected my mental health, and I need professional help to deal with these negative thought patterns.
growth_experiences: intense Self-doubt began to appear after not yet receiving an offer from the most recent interview; then the problem worsened as multiple interviews did not result in hiring. She experiences negative predictions and Self-denial with every job application or interview, has tried self-affirmation and networking but it has not yet noticeably helped. Overall family support, but she chooses not to discuss job-search Anxiety with family.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, not worthy of being hired

special_situations.event: the most recent interview did not yet result in an offer
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if one interview fails, it means I am not good enough, and predicts that all future ones will fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to raise confidence through self-affirmation and expanding connections, but inwardly still tending to focus on negative outcomes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never convince employers to hire me

special_situations.event: Each moment of submitting a resume or attending an interview
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I have not immediately seen positive signals, it is equivalent to Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: do negative rehearsals before interviews, lower expectations for Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely be Being rejected again this time

special_situations.event: Nervousness and stumbling answers during interviews
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if my performance is not perfect, it means I am not professional, I will not be hired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: repeatedly blame myself, replay interview details, do not proactively seek emotional support from family
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I messed this one up, no one will want me

special_situations.event: after the interview, no clear feedback received yet, only told 'they will reply'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if they go Silence or delay feedback, it means being negated, and it is my fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing with family, continuously immersed in negative speculation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: having no news means Being rejected, because I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted by the employer and to obtain stable work to care for family
core_conflict.fear: afraid of Being rejected and being negated, worried about being unable to support the family and thus being seen as having no value
defense_goal: through Anticipation of the worst to reduce the pain when Being rejected
avoid discussing job-search Anxiety with family to protect the self, avoid exposing vulnerability

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, a job seeker prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: picky, a judge with the power to negate (employer/interviewer)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when the counselor invites her to list strengths or challenge the 'I am not good enough' prediction
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: feels she must produce sufficient evidence to prove herself, otherwise she will still be negated in the end
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: tone flat, emphasize external conditions or the conclusion that 'it is not much use', such as 'speaking three languages did not help either'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: when talking about interview setbacks or not yet receiving an offer
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: attribute complex causes to her own flaws, subconsciously Turning against the self with disappointment and frustration
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: tone self-blaming, lower self-worth, such as 'it is that I am not good enough', avoid expressing reasonable dissatisfaction with the external situation.

manifestations: despite family support, do not share job-search Anxiety and post-rejection feelings with family
when facing career uncertainty, choose to bear the pressure alone
outcomes: Attention and daily functioning are affected; mood is depressed

manifestations: After multiple job rejections, doubting my own ability and the value of my efforts
treat one or a few failures as a complete negate of self-worth
outcomes: more prone to catastrophizing and the belief that 'I will never be hired'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: frequently belittle the self with absolutist language (such as 'I am not good enough' 'I can never find Work')
immediately negate their value when acknowledging her own strengths (such as 'speaking three languages is of no use either')
In sessions, stays cautious and keeps expectations low; hard to let positive information in

positive_force: Multilingual ability (fluent in English, French, and Spanish), a transferable career advantage
The family as a whole is supportive, willing to provide encouragement and help in difficult times
proactively seek professional help, willing to try identifying and challenging negative thinking
Can list her own strengths and cooperate with exercises (such as reality testing, strengths list)
Continuously conducting job interviews and network expansion, with a certain capacity for action
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and jumping to conclusions
Self-denial and labeling ('I am a failure' 'I am not good enough')
Negative mental filtering: tends to focus on negative outcomes such as rejection and ignore personal strengths
avoid expressing Anxiety to family and seeking support, resulting in the support system not yet being fully utilized
In interviews, nervousness affects performance; delayed feedback is equated with rejection and blamed on myself

target_behavior.behavior: catastrophizing and Self-denial automatic thoughts and speech appear in job-search-related situations (such as 'I can never find Work'), accompanied by Low mood and Decreased drive
antecedent: Submitting resumes or preparing for interviews
no clear feedback received yet after the interview
target_behavior.core_reason: Accumulated experiences of repeated rejection, intense focus on negative outcomes, and pressure from financial responsibility toward the family have formed catastrophizing predictions of failure and self-labeling
target_behavior.function: avoid the disappointment and shame brought by rejection, gain a superficial sense of control over the uncertain future (through Anticipating the worst for Self-protection)
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety and Depression worsen, interview performance further deteriorates, daily focus and Decreased motivation decline

target_behavior.behavior: avoid expressing job-search Anxiety to family and seeking emotional support
antecedent: Depression moments after being rejected or not yet receiving a reply
Feels shame when discussing own weaknesses or interview mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Worried about increasing others' burden and exposing vulnerability, tending to internalize pressure
target_behavior.function: avoid feelings of potential judgment or being negated, temporarily maintain the concealment of vulnerability and Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet fully utilized, Loneliness and negative thinking worsen, emotional Recovery slows
